outcome: Timing of first postpartum venous thromboembolism (VTE)
cohort: Women with pregnancies resulting in live and stillbirth births
finding: The duration of increased VTE risk after childbirth varies based on the type of risk factors and can extend up to the first 3 to 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Women with a BMI > 30 kg/m2 or those having cesarean delivery also had elevated VTE rates up to 6 weeks postpartum.
